fields.title: Refund policy (30-day)
fields.body: New paid plans are eligible for a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are issued to the original payment method and take 5–10 business days. Refunds must be approved by a human agent before processing.

fields.title: Export notes to Markdown / PDF
fields.body: Notes export from Settings → Data → Export. Choose Markdown, PDF, or a full ZIP archive. Large workspaces (10k+ notes) export as a background job and email a download link within an hour. The link expires after 24 hours.

fields.title: Sync stuck / offline changes not appearing
fields.body: If a device shows an outdated version: 1) confirm it is online, 2) pull to refresh the workspace, 3) sign out and back in to force a full resync. Conflicting edits are preserved as a duplicate note titled 'Conflicted copy'. No data is lost.

fields.title: Enable / reset two-factor authentication
fields.body: Enable 2FA in Settings → Security. If a user is locked out, they can use a saved recovery code. Without a recovery code, identity must be verified before we reset 2FA — never disable 2FA on an unverified request.

fields.title: Add or remove team seats
fields.body: Workspace owners manage seats in Settings → Billing → Team. Adding a seat is prorated for the current cycle; removing a seat credits the unused portion to the next invoice. Seat changes take effect immediately.

fields.title: Import notes from Evernote or Markdown
fields.body: Import from Settings → Data → Import. Choose Evernote (.enx), a Markdown folder, or a ZIP of Markdown files. Notebooks become tags and attachments come across with their notes. Large imports (5k+ notes) run in the background and email you when they finish.

fields.title: Share a note with someone outside your team
fields.body: Open the note, tap Share, and choose 'Anyone with the link (view only)'. Copy the link and send it: viewers do not need an account. Revoke the link at any time from the same Share menu. Links stay active until you revoke them; expiry dates are not available yet.

fields.title: Macro: first-response acknowledgement
fields.body: Hi {{name}}, thanks for reaching out to Nimbus Notes — I'm looking into this now and will follow up shortly with next steps.

fields.title: Macro: resolved follow-up
fields.body: Glad that's sorted, {{name}}! I'll close this ticket for now — just reply here anytime if anything else comes up. A quick rating helps us a lot.
